Ruling: batch #192 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「192 同意」 2026-09-20T09:24Z

Director seat, summon #25, `session_012GcsUbuqFGBibkEDMRC1eE`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **B**; the maintainer agreed 「192 同意」. Thread re-read to its last comment (none) in the act that wrote this. Readings taken in this act: PR #18962 open draft, head `2471df228d`, +1410/−44 over 9 files, its test named 「derives exactly three directory spellings per package」; `packages/spec/src/system/doc.zod.ts:65-67` (`DocSchema.name`: namespace prefix recommended, not required); hotcrm's layout `src/<id tail>/`; no in-repo consumer resolves a docs directory by `name` (partially unverified: this seat read the PR head and the hotcrm layout, ⛔ not every example).

## Ruling — **B**

The per-package docs directory is resolved by the package **`id`** and by the **id tail** only. The display name **`name`** is ⛔ not a directory key: it is a display field that is expected to change, and a rename would silently stop a package's docs from being collected while `os build` still exits 0. **A refused** (it would publish a display field as a filesystem key with zero consumers). **C refused** by the standing 「不渐进」 ruling (2026-08-27): no experimental spelling, no window.

Four-facet reading (this seat's own): ① one ownership relation, one key — npm workspaces, Cargo workspaces and Maven modules all resolve by package identifier or path, never by a display name; ② zero pull for `name` as a directory key today, and this capability is unreleased, so the narrowing costs nothing now and a breaking change later; ③ a renamed display name silently uncollects docs — the worst failure shape; ④ every published spelling is a permanent obligation.

## Execution, same stroke

`needs-user-decision` off and this card closed `completed` — its deliverable rides PR #18962. The holding `domain:cli` seat patches PR #18962 in one round before its next at-tier review: narrow the acceptor to `id` + id tail; change the `cli.mdx` sentence to two spellings; the test 「derives exactly three directory spellings per package」 becomes two; and, per `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` rule 4, the same patch carries a warning when a docs directory matches no package (the dev verifies first whether such a diagnostic already exists and adds one only if it does not). PR #18962's `Blocked-by: #19250` is discharged by this close.
